entries.proposition: The paper states the transcriptional response to MeHg is very limited, while VPA tables are large (thousands of probe sets).
entries.snippet: the transcriptional response of differentiating hESC to MeHg is indeed very limited
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, para on numbers of regulated PS

entries.proposition: In the UKK system exposure runs across a 14-day embryoid-body differentiation (all germ layers).
entries.snippet: the EBs were maintained for 14 days on a horizontal shaker with or without drug treatment

entries.proposition: In the UKN1 system, neural induction by dual SMAD inhibition, the chemical was present from day of differentiation 0 for 6 days.
entries.snippet: the cells were differentiated in the presence or absence of the chemicals from DoD 0 for 6 days

entries.proposition: The JRC system is an embryoid-body-derived early neuroepithelial (rosette) culture kept for up to 10 days.
entries.snippet: Cultures were kept for up to 10 days with medium changes every third day.

entries.proposition: The test concentration is the benchmark concentration, defined by a 10 percent viability loss, not a therapeutic exposure.
entries.snippet: the highest concentration that reduced overall cell viability by not more than 10 %
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, para on BMC determination

entries.proposition: The 2012 paper's own caution: significance depends on FDR correction; before correction 2524 up-regulated PS at 500 uM VPA in UKK, after correction four.
entries.snippet: the number of 2524 PS that appeared to be significantly up-regulated before FDR correction dropped down to four really significant PS after FDR correction

entries.proposition: Concentrations the authors call human-relevant for VPA are 500-1000 uM; the assay BMC sits in the millimolar range.
The supplement defines fold change as ratio: below 1 is down, above 1 is up.
entries.snippet: the corresponding fold changes of the PS (<1 = down-regulated; >1 = up-regulated)
